_comment: Reference values for cp2k-geoopt-nh3 (CP2K 2024.1, PBE/DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH, NH3 geoopt). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: NH3 PBE/DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH geoopt, 6 BFGS steps. 6 oracle runs produced identical values (energy spread 2e-15 Ha, bond spread 0). Tolerances set to physical minimum resolution: energy 1e-5 Ha, bond 1e-3 A. Cross-verify: verifier reruns a single point on the agent's final geometry; deterministic to ~1e-10, tol 1e-6.
